category_title: Disengaged ninth grader struggling with decoding and social anxiety
minimal_context: Harry is sitting with a tutor who is reading a text aloud while Harry is asked to follow along in his own book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to read this passage aloud now. Please follow along with the text in your book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are you keeping up with where I am reading?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I keep losing my place.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying to follow the words.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm struggling to follow along with the words. Looking at the words is just becoming a distraction and leading to my inability to focus.
